title: Office User: role permissions match the expected set
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Office User role.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Office User role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
custom_expected: The Office User permissions match the expected set: Work orders View only; Work order lines off; Schedule View only; Customers full (including Delete); Part sales View only; Catalog and Inventory View only; Vendor and order management View only; Invoicing & payments View only; Reports on; See Financial Data on; View and Manage AP/AR Data on; several Settings pages on; Timesheets View/Create & Edit; View mode Full View. The Office User role is non-editable (lock icon).
viu_status: Roles-API-Verified (permission set matches the live role); workflow spot-checks Blocked-UI
evidence: Office User permission set confirmed live via GET /api/roles/{id} (roles-matrix-2026-07-13).
